narrative:
Group opex is planned at NOK 1,010M (+4.1%), 59.8% of gross profit, so adjusted EBITDA conversion is about 40%. Personnel is NOK 640M, platform and cloud NOK 185M, sales and marketing NOK 120M, G&A NOK 65M.

Cost-to-serve differs widely by product. The CPaaS Engagement Platform carries the highest platform cost share (22-27% of GP), and International OTP and wholesale run above the FY2025 cost index because traffic still runs on legacy SMSC platforms inherited from acquisitions.

The Opex Efficiency Agent links platform consolidation onto MyLINK CORE, committed-use cloud discounts and a single data platform (replacing a separate Databricks/Spark estate) to lower cost-to-serve.

signals.title: Platform consolidation programme
signals.excerpt: 4 legacy SMSC/messaging platforms from acquired entities scheduled for migration onto MyLINK CORE; Databricks/Spark analytics estate under review (technology decision end-2026).

signals.title: MyLINK CORE — Group Strategy Update
signals.excerpt: Group ambition: double-digit gross profit growth driven by conversational channels, verification and platform revenue on a consolidated MyLINK CORE stack.
